- id: lem:cmh-linear-spectral-resolution
    kind: lemma
    status: proved
    provenance: internal
    file: modules/kls/41-cmh-normalization.tex
    summary: 'For a regular isotropic compact-target moment map with source potential $\psi$, Stein generator $A_{\mathrm{op}}=-L$ in source coordinates, and columns $Ha=\nabla(\partial_a\psi)$: the $u_b=\partial_b\psi$ are centered orthonormal eigenfunctions of $A_{\mathrm{op}}$ at its Brascamp--Lieb spectral gap $1$; the columns lie in the form domain and satisfy the weak column equation $\mathcal{E}(f,Ha) = \langle f,Ha\rangle - \langle f,(A+Q)a\rangle$ for bounded smooth finite-energy $f$, with $(A+Q)a \in L^1$ orthogonal to every $u_b$ and $\mathbb{E}[A+Q]=I$; and with the induced decomposition $Ha = a + \sum_b M_{ab}u_b + v$ one has $a^T N a = 1+|M_a|^2+|v|^2$, $a^T D a = |M_a|^2+\langle v,A_{\mathrm{op}}v\rangle$, $a^T R a = 1 - \langle v,(A_{\mathrm{op}}-1)v\rangle$, where $\langle v,A_{\mathrm{op}}v\rangle$ is the closed-form value. Consequently $R \le I$ with equality iff the column fluctuation is spectrally pure at the gap; $(\mathrm{AB})_{\rho,\beta}$ is equivalent to $\langle v,(A_{\mathrm{op}}-1)v\rangle + \rho(|M_a|^2+|v|^2) \le 1+\beta-\rho$ for all unit $a$; $R \ge N-nI$ holds unconditionally; and $R \ge D$ holds for all regular finite products of one-dimensional laws.'
    depends_on: ['thm:regular-moment-map-compact-target', 'def:cmh']
    proofs:
      - artifact: solutions/lem-cmh-linear-spectral-resolution.tex
        mode: agent
        review: research/reviews/2026-09-06-lem-cmh-linear-spectral-resolution-proof-review.md

- id: lem:linear-sector-third-moment
    kind: lemma
    status: proved
    provenance: internal
    file: modules/kls/41-cmh-normalization.tex
    summary: 'For an isotropic log-concave $\mu$ that is the moment measure of a $C^2$ convex $\varphi$ with $\mathbb{E}_\nu\|D^2\varphi\|_{\mathrm{HS}}^2$ finite, and canonical Stein kernel $\tau$, each column decomposes orthogonally in $L^2(\mu;\mathbb{R}^n)$ as $\tau a = a + (1/2)T_3(a)X + v_a$ with $\mathbb{E}v_a = 0$ and $\mathbb{E}[v_a \otimes X] = 0$, where $T_3(a) = \mathbb{E}[\langle X,a\rangle X\otimes X]$; hence $\mathbb{E}|\tau a|^2 = |a|^2 + (1/4)\|T_3(a)\|_{\mathrm{HS}}^2 + \mathbb{E}|v_a|^2$. Equivalently $\mathbb{E}_\nu[\partial_{ij}\varphi\,\partial_k\varphi] = (1/2)\mathbb{E}_\mu[X_iX_jX_k]$; when $\varphi$ is $C^3$ with $D^3\varphi \in L^1(\nu)$ this identifies the gap-mode coefficient tensor $\mathbb{E}_\nu[\partial_{ijk}\varphi]$ of the linear-sector gate-matrix spectral resolution with half the third-moment tensor.'
    proofs:
      - artifact: solutions/lem-linear-sector-third-moment.tex
        mode: agent
        review: research/reviews/2026-09-06-lem-linear-sector-third-moment-proof-review.md

- id: cor:gate-zero-third-moment
    kind: corollary
    status: proved
    provenance: internal
    file: modules/kls/41-cmh-normalization.tex
    summary: 'Under the linear-sector third-moment decomposition, for every unit $a$: $\|T_3(a)\|_{\mathrm{HS}}^2 \le 4(a^T\mathbb{E}[\tau^2]a - 1) \le 4(\lambda_{\max}(\mathbb{E}\tau^2)-1)$. So $\mathbb{E}\tau^2 \le c\,\mathrm{Id}$ on a class forces every directional third moment there to be at most $2\sqrt{c-1}$: gate zero gives $2\sqrt{3}$, sharp gate zero gives the sharp $2$; and any isotropic law in the class with a directional third moment above $2\sqrt{3}$ refutes gate zero.'
    depends_on: ['lem:linear-sector-third-moment']
    proofs:
      - artifact: solutions/lem-linear-sector-third-moment.tex
        mode: agent
        review: research/reviews/2026-09-06-lem-linear-sector-third-moment-proof-review.md

- id: def:exponential-cone
    kind: definition
    status: defined
    provenance: internal
    file: modules/kls/42-cmh-exact-cases.tex
    summary: 'For $n \ge 2$, a convex body $K \subset \mathbb{R}^{n-1}$ with barycenter $0$, the open cone $C_K = \{(x_1,x''): x_1 > 0,\ x''/x_1 \in \mathrm{int}\,K\}$, and $\beta \ge n$, the exponential cone measure $\mu_{K,\beta}$ has density proportional to $x_1^{\beta-n}e^{-x_1}$ on $C_K$, and $\bar\mu_{K,\beta}$ is its centering (the law of $X-\beta e_1$). It is log-concave, $X = S(1,U)$ with $S \sim \Gamma(\beta,1)$ and $U \sim \mathrm{Unif}(K)$ independent, $\mathbb{E}X = \beta e_1$, and $\mathrm{Cov}\,X = \beta e_1e_1^T \oplus \beta(\beta+1)\mathrm{Cov}(U)$.'

- id: prop:cone-moment-map
    kind: proposition
    status: proved
    provenance: internal
    file: modules/kls/42-cmh-exact-cases.tex
    summary: 'Cone lift of the moment map: if lambda is the moment potential of Unif(beta K), the moment potential of bar mu_{K,beta} is phi(y_1,y'') = exp(y_1 + lambda(y'')/beta) - beta y_1 + log Gamma(beta), grad phi is a diffeomorphism of R^n onto C_K - beta e_1, and the canonical Stein kernel at x - beta e_1, x = (x_1, x_1 u), is x_1 [[1, u^T],[u, u u^T + beta tau_K(u)]] with tau_K the canonical Stein kernel of Unif(K). In particular tau e_1 = x, the position vector.'
    depends_on: ['thm:regular-moment-map-compact-target']
    proofs:
      - artifact: solutions/prop-cone-moment-map.tex
        mode: agent
        review: research/reviews/2026-09-06-prop-cone-moment-map-proof-review.md

- id: prop:cone-linear-sector
    kind: proposition
    status: proved
    provenance: internal
    file: modules/kls/42-cmh-exact-cases.tex
    summary: 'For $\mu = \bar\mu_{K,\beta}$: (i) the field $x = \tau e_1$ has $\mathrm{Div}_\mu x = -\bar x_1$ with zero boundary flux and $x = \Sigma\nabla\psi$ with $\psi = x^T\Sigma^{-1}x/2$, so the first Stein column has no solenoidal part and the affine $H^{-1}$ norm of $\bar x_1$ is $\mathbb{E}[x^T\Sigma^{-1}x] = \beta+n$, attained at $\psi$; (ii) the normalized gate matrix in the axis direction equals $1+n/\beta \le 2$, with equality iff $\beta=n$, and this is the CMH Rayleigh quotient at $g=x_1$; (iii) in isotropic coordinates $T_3(e_1) = 2\beta^{-1/2}\mathrm{Id}$, $\tau_Z e_1 = e_1 + (1/2)T_3(e_1)Z$, so $\|T_3(e_1)\|_{\mathrm{HS}}^2 = 4n/\beta$ and the high-mode term $v_{e_1}$ of the linear-sector third-moment decomposition vanishes for every base and every $\beta \ge n$. Every exponential cone with $\beta = n$ saturates sharp gate zero in its axis direction and attains $\|T_3(e_1)\|_{\mathrm{HS}} = 2$.'
    depends_on: ['prop:cone-moment-map']
    proofs:
      - artifact: solutions/prop-cone-moment-map.tex
        mode: agent
        review: research/reviews/2026-09-06-prop-cone-moment-map-proof-review.md

- id: cor:cube-cone-gate-zero
    kind: corollary
    status: proved
    provenance: internal
    file: modules/kls/42-cmh-exact-cases.tex
    summary: 'For $K = [-1,1]^{n-1}$, $\tau_K(u) = (1/2)\mathrm{diag}(1-u_j^2)$ and the normalized gate matrix of $\bar\mu_{K,\beta}$ is $(1+n/\beta) \oplus ((6\beta^2+11\beta+5n+4)/(5\beta(\beta+1)))\mathrm{Id}_{n-1}$. Both eigenvalues are at most $2$ for all $n \ge 2$ and $\beta \ge n$, so every cube cone satisfies sharp gate zero; equality holds in the axis direction iff $\beta = n$ and in the transverse directions only for $n = \beta = 2$, the product of two centered exponentials.'
    depends_on: ['prop:cone-moment-map']
    proofs:
      - artifact: solutions/prop-cone-moment-map.tex
        mode: agent
        review: research/reviews/2026-09-06-prop-cone-moment-map-proof-review.md

- id: lem:fiber-root-degree-two
    kind: lemma
    status: proved
    provenance: internal
    file: modules/kls/45-conditional-fiber-frame.tex
    summary: 'For every $m\ge3$, on the degree-$\le2$ quotient $V_{m,2}$ of $L^2$ of the isotropic uniform simplex modulo constants, the $A_{m-1}$ root-frame pair form $K(f,f)=(12/(m^2(m+1)))\sum_{i<j}\mathbb{E}[\mathrm{Var}_{ij}(f)/(P_i+P_j)^2]$ and $G=\mathrm{Var}$ satisfy $\lambda_{\min}(K,G)=(m+2)(m+3)/(5m^2)$, attained exactly on the radial line $\mathbb{R}[|X|^2-(m-1)]$. Granting the certified root-pencil identification, every degree-two dual certificate in the all-frame min-max framework has objective at least $(m+2)(m+3)/(5m^2) > 1/5$, so any fixed-degree polynomial dual refuter requires degree at least three and $\Lambda_{m,2} \ge (m+2)(m+3)/(5m^2)$. No upper bound on $\Lambda_{m,2}$, no degree-three statement, and no full-$L^2$ claim.'
    depends_on: ['lem:conditional-fiber-form', 'prop:conditional-fiber-root-obstruction']
    proofs:
      - artifact: solutions/lem-fiber-root-degree-two.tex
        mode: agent
        review: research/reviews/2026-09-06-lem-fiber-root-degree-two-proof-review.md
